text:
Riya (CS): Hey team — heads-up: several onboarding tenants in eu-west-2 are seeing delayed embedding refreshes after last night's maintenance. Customers reporting search hits returning outdated results. Opening thread to coordinate comms, credits, and enablement sessions.

Alex (SRE): Investigating. Early signal: embed-writer worker pool dropped to 0 for ~18m due to a post-deploy init ordering bug; backlog grew and some jobs expired.

Jon (Eng): Root cause triage: init ordering meant the shard-router started after the writer; writers failed fast and system retried less aggressively, leading to expirations. Canary didn't exercise the exact startup sequence.

Marta (Support): Ticket list: ONB-8001, ONB-8008, ONB-8012, ONB-8020. A few customers are in renewal conversations and asking about SLA impact.

Alex (SRE): No permanent data loss — expired jobs were re-generated from source and backfilled after we fixed the init order. Impact window roughly 02:1402:32 UTC. We'll attach job IDs to tickets.

Riya (CS): Communication requirements: 1) short status to all affected now; 2) tailored RCA/timeline for renewal-risk accounts; 3) compensation tiering (renewal-risk vs trialers); 4) schedule enablement office hours and capture feedback.

Jon (Eng): Draft short status message: "Hi — we experienced a temporary delay in embedding updates for a small set of onboarding tenants in eu-west-2 between 02:1402:32 UTC due to an unintended init-order change during maintenance. We reverted the change and ran prioritized backfills; embeddings should now be current. No customer vectors were lost. Please reply if you continue to see stale results. — Redwood Inference Ops"

Marta (Support): I'll send that to the open tickets now. For compensation: proposing renewal-risk accounts receive a 1-month service credit + 2-hr private ops review; onboarding trial customers get a 72-hour trial extension. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

Ezra (Solutions): Sounds fair. For renewal-risk accounts also offer a pre-scheduled 1:1 with Solutions to ensure demos are green. That helps retention.

Alex (SRE): Mitigations to include in RCA: fix init ordering in the deploy chart, add a startup smoke that verifies writer->router handshake, and gate deploys if embed-backlog > threshold. Also add synthetic canary hitting onboarding flow.

Riya (CS): Good. Can we get a short timeline block for the exec RCA?

Jon (Eng): Timeline bullets: 02:10 UTC  maintenance started; 02:14 UTC  writers failed due to router not ready; 02:18 UTC  backlog increase alert; 02:22 UTC  rollback of init change; 02:32 UTC  prioritized backfill completed for known tenants; 02:40 UTC  health checks green.

Marta (Support): Sent short status to tickets and added the timeline placeholder. A couple of customers replied asking for confirmation their demos are fixed.

Riya (CS): I'll prepare two email templates: concise status for all, and an expanded exec RCA including timeline, root cause, remediation, and compensations for renewal-risk accounts. Will paste drafts here for approval before send.

Alex (SRE): Adding alert rule: if writer_pool_size == 0 for >1m then page infra. Also instrument startup ordering metric and alert if router-ready timestamp > writer-ready timestamp on >=2 replicas.

Ezra (Solutions): I'll draft the invite copy for the enablement office hours. Recommend two slots: next-day 15:00 UTC (general) and 17:00 UTC (private for renewal-risk). Include a 3-question feedback form: "was your demo impacted?", "did our mitigation meet expectations?", "would you like a follow-up 1:1?"

Marta (Support): I attached backfill job IDs to tickets: job-4589, job-4590, job-4597, job-4602. Customers acknowledged the updates.

NotifyBot: Rollback of init-order change completed at 02:22 UTC. System health checks returned green at 02:40 UTC. :white_check_mark:

Riya (CS): Compensation and send cadence: short status to be sent now; personalized exec RCA + compensation offers to renewal-risk accounts by 12:30 UTC; office hour invites in follow-up email. Approve?

Jon (Eng): Approve. We'll also open a follow-up ticket on the product board to implement the synthetic canary and startup handshake check.

Marta (Support): Short status posted. I'll queue the personalized exec notes for the flagged renewal accounts once Riya pastes the final template.

Riya (CS): Pasting short exec RCA draft here for review: "Subject: Incident summary  embedding refresh delay (eu-west-2)

Hi [Name],

Between 02:1402:32 UTC on [date], your tenant experienced a temporary delay in embedding updates due to an init-order regression during maintenance which prevented our embedding writer from connecting to the shard router. We reverted the change and ran prioritized backfills; embeddings for known impacted tenants are current. No customer data was lost.

Actions taken:
- Reverted the init-order change and redeployed validated chart
- Prioritized backfill for impacted tenants (job IDs attached)
- Added alerting on writer pool size and startup-order anomaly detection
- Added synthetic canary for onboarding embedding freshness

As a gesture of apology we'd like to offer [compensation tier]. We'd also like to invite you to a private ops review to confirm demo readiness.

Best,
Riya & Redwood Ops"

Ezra (Solutions): Minor wording tweak: replace "init-order regression" with "startup ordering bug". Otherwise good.

Riya (CS): Updated. Final checklist: 1) attach impacted tenant list (Riya) 2) confirm backfill job IDs attached (Marta) 3) support to send exec notes to flagged renewals (Marta) 4) schedule office hours and include survey (Ezra).

Alex (SRE): Confirmed metrics show writers stable and embed freshness >99% for monitored tenants as of 02:40 UTC.

Marta (Support): Exec emails queued; sending at 12:28 UTC. I'll paste copies here after send.

Riya (CS): Thanks team. I'll follow up on feedback from the office hours and update the RCA with any learnings. Closing thread. :pray:
